id: title:gantoine:point at worktrees clean when disk runs low

review.posthog_relevance: Adds CLI hints and documentation for hogli worktree cleanup and configuration parameters, without changing hogli implementation.
review.reason: Adds a CLI hint and documentation for hogli worktree cleanup and configuration parameters, without changing hogli implementation.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation and registration of the disk-space precheck configuration are not shown in the supplied hunks, so the tier is assigned conservatively based on the visible documentation and CLI hint additions.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single group. No tier assignment is made; tier is assigned after all hunks are reviewed.

observations.behavior: Adds a yellow-tip message in the worktree setup script, suggesting a hogli command to preview reclaimable worktrees.
observations.code_quote: print_color yellow "Each worktree takes several GB. To see which old worktrees you can clear, run 'hogli worktrees:clean --before 7d --mode deps --dry-run'."
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a CLI hint to PostHog engineers to reclaim disk space before running hogli, without changing hogli behavior.

observations.behavior: Updates documentation to describe hogli worktrees:clean command and its options.
observations.code_quote: To clear old `phw`, Claude Code, Codex, and PostHog Code worktrees in bulk, run `hogli worktrees:clean --before 7d --mode deps --dry-run` to preview, then drop `--dry-run`, or use `--mode full` to remove whole worktrees.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds documentation for PostHog engineers using hogli, not a change to hogli implementation.

observations.behavior: Adds a disk-space and worktree-count precheck configuration to hogli.yaml, including min_free_gib and max_worktrees.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines configuration parameters for a disk-space precheck, but the actual implementation and registration are not shown in this hunk.
